threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'overground' instead of just 'the train'—locals know it's just a hop to the Victoria Park for a pint.
Last night, the 59 was packed with a group trying to harmonize Adele's 'Someone Like You'. Half the bus joined in around Brixton station.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Passing the back entrance of Tempelhofer Feld, I spotted a group of kids BMXing with their own ramps. Just another afternoon of spontaneous joy, typical Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, you can find a spontaneous street performance by an opera singer at 3 AM. Only in Berlin will they belt arias while the rest of us are drunk on döner.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can spot the difference between fresh tacos at La Taqueria and those sad ones from a Stand. It’s a taste thing.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today with a lively street performer belting out classics. Riders were grinning, momentarily forgetting the delays looming ahead.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just grab a quick drink at any bar. But the locals know, post-8 PM, the best spots are packed with families enjoying their evening.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always look bewildered trying to navigate the winding streets and often end up stopping to take photos of the quirky buildings.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still stand in the middle of the pavement when someone says 'excuse me' instead of shifting aside. Classic rookie mistake.
Caught a glimpse of a busker on the 57 singing 90s R&B last night; even the driver stopped to listen for a minute. Brixton’s night vibe is unmatched.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a group of kids using a bus stop sign as a goalpost in the park. Just another day in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a late-night döner and find a spontaneous rave under the U-Bahn bridge. The blend of chaos and culture is unmatched.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they can tell you which taco truck's salsa packs a kick without needing Yelp—it's all about the right vibes at 3 AM.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus where the driver had a full-on convo with a regular about last night's Giants game. Only in the Tenderloin do strangers share their lives like that.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the vibrant street life is spontaneous, but it’s often pinned down by strict local permits. Watch how many times events get cancelled.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by the way they earnestly ask for directions to Parc Güell like it’s some hidden gem, not a tourist trap.
